description: This file defines the DiagnosisDAO interface in the OpenMRS project, which specifies database operations related to diagnosis entities, such as saving, retrieving, and deleting diagnoses and associated attribute types.

classes.name: DiagnosisDAO
classes.description: Interface defining database methods for diagnosis objects within the OpenMRS system, including CRUD operations and retrieval based on specific criteria.

methods.name: saveDiagnosis
methods.description: Saves a diagnosis object to the database, returning the saved instance.

methods.name: getDiagnosisById
methods.description: Retrieves a diagnosis from the database based on its unique ID.

methods.name: getDiagnosisByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a diagnosis from the database using its UUID.

methods.name: deleteDiagnosis
methods.description: Deletes a given diagnosis object from the database.

methods.name: getDiagnosesByEncounter
methods.description: Retrieves diagnoses associated with a specific encounter, with options to filter by primary or confirmed diagnoses.

methods.name: getDiagnosesByVisit
methods.description: Retrieves diagnoses associated with a specific visit, with filtering options.

methods.name: getActiveDiagnoses
methods.description: Returns all active diagnoses for a patient from a specified start date.

methods.name: getAllDiagnosisAttributeTypes
methods.description: Returns all diagnosis attribute types available.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeTypeById
methods.description: Retrieves a diagnosis attribute type based on its ID.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a diagnosis attribute type using its UUID.

methods.name: saveDiagnosisAttributeType
methods.description: Saves or updates a diagnosis attribute type.

methods.name: deleteDiagnosisAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes a specified diagnosis attribute type.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a diagnosis attribute by its UUID.
